race.comment: RYE MANHATTAN (12) was given time to settle then went through her gears nicely to finish second when resuming over 1500m at Newcastle last start. Lightly raced filly who should relish getting out to this distance for the first time. Plenty to like about her prospects. MARKOS PORT (5) made it three minor placings from as many runs when he worked home well but found a couple slightly better over the mile at Warwick Farm last time. Expect to see the Tulloch Lodge bone and muscle as he steps out further in trip. Sure to give a great sight. VISION IN A DREAM (9) went back from a wide gate then stoked up nicely to finish third when second-up over 1500m at Kembla recently. Gives every indication she will run this trip out strongly. GOLD CUP (7) started favourite but gave up rather meekly first-up at Newcastle. Can do better with a bit less pressure up front today. FRANKIE'S BOY (3) is fitter for two runs back from a spell and the extra 200m is a good option.
